newsHighlights.title: China launches 6G innovation pilot across eight provinces and municipalities
newsHighlights.summary: China's top industry regulator launched a ministry-province collaborative pilot program for 6G innovation and development in Shanghai on Tuesday, covering eight provinces and municipalities.
newsHighlights.translation: 中国最高行业主管部门周二在上海启动了省部协同的6G创新发展试点项目，覆盖八个省市。

newsHighlights.title: Pakistani astronaut set to become first foreign crew member aboard Tiangong
newsHighlights.summary: Pakistani astronaut Muhammad Zeeshan Ali is preparing for the Shenzhou XXIV mission and is set to become the first foreign crew member aboard China's Tiangong space station.
newsHighlights.translation: 巴基斯坦宇航员穆罕默德·齐尚·阿里正在备战神舟二十四号任务，将成为中国天宫空间站的首位外国乘组成员。

newsHighlights.title: Shenzhou-24 mission to conduct over 90 space experiments, tests
newsHighlights.summary: The Shenzhou-24 mission will conduct more than 90 space experiments and tests during its stay in orbit.
newsHighlights.translation: 神舟二十四号任务在轨期间将开展90多项空间实验与测试。

newsHighlights.title: Cook Islands scientist joins historic deep-sea dive
newsHighlights.summary: A Cook Islands scientist became the first person from her country to directly observe the deep-sea seabed within its exclusive economic zone aboard China's manned submersible.
newsHighlights.translation: 一位库克群岛科学家搭乘中国载人潜水器，成为首位在本国专属经济区内直接观察深海海床的库克群岛人。

newsHighlights.title: From cuisine to tech: China-France cooperation blossoms
newsHighlights.summary: China-France cooperation is expanding from cuisine to technology, with growing joint innovation projects and deeper scientific exchanges.
newsHighlights.translation: 中法合作正从美食拓展至科技领域，联合创新项目不断增多，科学交流日益深化。

quote.quote: Technology is a useful servant but a dangerous master.
quote.author: Christian Lous Lange
quote.translation: 技术是有用的仆人，却是危险的主人。
quote.explanation: 这句话提醒我们：科技应当为人类服务，而不应反过来控制人类。正如今天的6G、深海探测与载人航天，技术只有在被负责任地使用时，才能真正推动社会进步。

vocabulary.newsContext: 呼应库克群岛新闻中 "historic deep-sea dive" 所描述的开创性意义。

pattern.pattern: the first / the last + 名词 + to do sth（首位／最后一位做某事的……）
pattern.example: She became the first person from her country to directly observe the deep-sea seabed within its exclusive economic zone.
pattern.translation: 她成为首位在本国专属经济区内直接观察深海海床的人。
pattern.usage: 该句型用不定式作定语，修饰前面含序数词（the first, the second, the last）或最高级的名词，表示“第几个做某事的人／物”。也常见于新闻中的纪录性表达，如：He is set to become the first foreign crew member to board the Tiangong space station.

grammar.title: 序数词／最高级 + 不定式作定语（the first / last / only + to do）
grammar.explanation: 当名词前有 the first, the second, the last, the only 或最高级修饰时，后面常接动词不定式作定语，而不接 that 从句或介词短语。这一结构在新闻英语中高频出现，用于强调“首创性”“纪录性”。不定式的逻辑主语就是被修饰的名词，因此用主动形式表达被动含义。
examples: A scientist from the Cook Islands became the first person from her country to directly observe the deep-sea seabed.
Muhammad Zeeshan Ali is set to become the first foreign crew member to serve aboard the Tiangong space station.

pronunciation.tips: 重音在第三个音节 -va- 上，读作 in-uh-VAY-shn。注意 -tion 统一读 /ʃn/，不要读成 /tiən/。前两个音节弱读为 /ɪnə/，舌尖轻抵上齿龈发 /v/ 时上齿咬下唇。
examples: The 6G innovation pilot will cover eight provinces and municipalities.
International cooperation drives scientific and technological innovation.

reading.title: From 6G Networks to Deep-Sea Dives: Science Connects the World
reading.content:
China has taken a major step toward the future of communication. On Tuesday, the country's top industry regulator launched a ministry-province collaborative pilot program for 6G innovation and development in Shanghai. Eight provinces and municipalities, including Beijing, Hebei, Jiangsu and Zhejiang, are taking part in the project.

While 6G research advances on the ground, China's space program is also reaching new heights. The Shenzhou-24 mission is scheduled to conduct more than 90 space experiments and tests. Pakistani astronaut Muhammad Zeeshan Ali is preparing for the flight and is set to become the first foreign crew member to serve aboard the Tiangong space station.

Science is also connecting people under the sea. A scientist from the Cook Islands joined a dive aboard China's manned submersible and became the first person from her country to directly observe the deep-sea seabed within its exclusive economic zone.

From 6G networks to deep-sea exploration, technology is opening new doors for international cooperation.
reading.translation:
中国在通信未来的发展上迈出了重要一步。周二，中国最高行业主管部门在上海启动了省部协同的6G创新发展试点项目，北京、河北、江苏、浙江等八个省市参与其中。

在地面推进6G研究的同时，中国航天事业也在迈向新的高度。神舟二十四号任务计划开展90多项空间实验与测试。巴基斯坦宇航员穆罕默德·齐尚·阿里正在为这次飞行做准备，他将成为首位在天宫空间站执行任务的外国乘组成员。

科技也在海底把人们连接起来。一位库克群岛科学家搭乘中国载人潜水器参与下潜，成为首位在本国专属经济区内直接观察深海海床的库克群岛人。

从6G网络到深海探索，科技正为国际合作打开新的大门。
reading.sourceNote: 本文基于 2026-11-25 ChinaDaily 与 CGTN 真实新闻改写，主要素材包括：《China launches 6G innovation pilot across eight provinces and municipalities》《Pakistani astronaut set to become first foreign crew member aboard Tiangong》《Shenzhou-24 mission to conduct over 90 space experiments, tests》《Cook Islands scientist joins historic deep-sea dive》。
